s.how: Roast 1kg pork shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and fennel seeds at 160C for 3 hours, rest and slice thin. Fry 2 bunches broccolini with 3 garlic cloves and chilli. Pile the pork, greens and 150g sliced provolone into 12 slider buns and spoon over the pan juices.

s.note: the little red tent in Cole's room
s.how: Dip 500g dry strawberries in 150g melted dark chocolate. Before it sets, roll half of each in crushed freeze-dried raspberries so they're bright red. Chill on baking paper until set.

m.note: Malcolm late to his own anniversary dinner
m.how: Roast 4 salmon fillets skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes. Reduce a shallot with 100ml white wine, then whisk in 120g cold butter cube by cube. Crush 800g boiled potatoes with butter. Steam 2 bunches asparagus.

w.note: the room goes cold when they're close
w.how: Melt 150g white chocolate into 100ml warm cream and cool. Fold through 200ml whipped cream and 1 whisked egg white. Spoon into glasses and set 4 hours. Top with a few raspberries.

d.note: Cole's mum keeping the house warm
d.how: Brew 4 black tea bags in 1L just-boiled water for 3 minutes. Pour into 4 mugs, add a slice of lemon and a teaspoon of honey to each and stir.
